parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT o.id FROM outbox o
  WHERE o.status = 'pending'
     OR (o.status = 'processing' AND o.processing_started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes')
  ORDER BY o.created_at
  LIMIT 20
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE outbox o SET status = 'processing', processing_started_at = NOW(), attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL
  FROM candidates x WHERE o.id = x.id
  RETURNING o.id, o.contact_id, o.message_type, o.payload
)
SELECT claimed.id, claimed.contact_id AS "contactId", claimed.message_type AS "messageType", claimed.payload,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(claimed.payload->>'toPhone', ''), c.phone) AS phone,
       COALESCE((SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key = 'evolution_instance'), 'kit-matematica') AS "evolutionInstance"
FROM claimed JOIN contacts c ON c.id = claimed.contact_id;

parameters.query: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'sent', sent_at = NOW(), processing_started_at = NULL WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id;
UPDATE outbox SET status = 'failed', failed_at = NOW(), processing_started_at = NULL, last_error = LEFT($2, 1000) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id;
